Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በማደግ ላይ ባሉ አገሮች ውስጥ እስከ 15 ዓመት ዕድሜ ላላቸው ሕፃናት እድገትን ሞዴል ማድረግ ፈልገው ነበር፣ እና በመጨረሻም በጣም ተስማሚ የሆነውን የእድገት ገበታን ይስላሉ።

English: They used data from a study that examined poverty and health in children in Ethiopia, India, Peru and Vietnam.
Luganda: Baakozesa obubaka okuva mu kunoonyereza okwekaliriza obwavu n’obulamu bw’abaana mu Ethiopia, Buyindi, Peru ne Vietnam.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àmúlò dátà látí inuh iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò òṣì àti ìlera nínú àwọn ọmọdeh ní Ethiopia, India, Peru àti Vietnam.
Zulu: Basebenzise idatha yocwaningo oluhlola ubumpofu nempilo ezinganeni zaseTopiya, eNdiya, ePeru naseVietnam.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da bayanai daga wani binciken da ya yi nazarin talauci da lafiya a tsakanin yara a Habasha da Indiya da Peru da kuma Vietnam.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše Tshedimošo yeo e lekotšego bohloki le maphelo go bana ka Ethiopia, India, Peru le Vietnam.
Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ፣ ህንድ፣ ፔሩ እና ቬትናም የህጻናትን ድህነት እና ጤናን የመረመረውን ጥናት መረጃ ተጠቅመዋል።

English: They extracted growth information like height and weight, collected every 3 to 4 years, over 15 years from 2002 to 2016.
Luganda: Baggyamu obubaka obukwata ku nkula nga obuwanvu n’obuzito, obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa buli luvannyuma lwa myaka 3 okutuuka ku 4, mu bbanga lya myaka 15 okuva mu 2002 okutuuka mu 2016.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àfàyọ ìfitóniléti ajẹmọ ìdàgbàsóke bíi gíga àti fífẹ̀, wọ́n gba gbogbo ọduhn 3 sí 4, fún ọdún 15 láti ọdún 2002 sí 2016.
Zulu: Bakhiphe imininingwane yokukhula njengobude nesisindo, eqoqwe njalo eminyakeni emi-3 kuya kwemi-4, eminyakeni eyi-15 ukusuka ku-2002 kuya ku-2016.
Hausa: Sun fitar da bayanan girma kamar tsayi da kuma nauyi, da aka tattara a duk shekaru 3 zuwa 4, sama da shekaru 15 daga shekarar 2002 zuwa shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ntšha Tshedimošo ya mabapi le kgolo ya go swana le botelele le boima, ba e kgoboketša mengwaga ye mengwe le ye mengwe ye 3 go fihla go ye 4, mo mengwageng ye 15 go thoma ka 2002 go fihla ka 2016.
Amharic: ከ2002 እስከ 2016 ባሉ 15 ዓመታት በላይ፣ በየ 3 እና 4 ዓመታት የሚሰበሰቡትን እንደ ቁመት እና ክብደት ያሉ የእድገት መረጃዎችን ለይተው አውጥተዋል።

English: They tested and compared different models that could best represent children’s growth in poor countries.
Luganda: Baagezesa era ne bageraageranya emitetenkanyirizo egy’enjawulo egyali gisobola okukiikirira obulungi enkula y’abaana mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò àti àfiwé ìyàtò àwọm àpẹẹrẹ tí ó le è dúró déédé fún ìdàgbàsókè àwọn ọmọdeh ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí kò ní tó.
Zulu: Bahlola futhi baqhathanisa amamodeli ahlukene angamelela kangcono ukukhula kwezingane emazweni ampofu.
Hausa: Sun gwada da kwatanta nau’in samfurori daban-daban da za su iya wakiltar ci gaban yara a cikin ƙasashe matalauta.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba leka le go bapetša mekgwa ye e fapafapanego yeo e ka emelago bokaone kgolo ya bana ka dinageng tšeo di hlokago.
Amharic: በድሃ አገሮች ውስጥ የልጆችን እድገት በተሻለ ሁኔታ ሊወክሉ የሚችሉ የተለያዩ ሞዴሎችን ሞክረው አነጻጽረዋል።

English: The researchers observed that growth among the children differed across gender and by country.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza ne balaba nti enkula mu baana yali eyawuka ng’otunuula ekikula n’ensi mwe bava.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ṣe akíyèsí pé ìdàgbàsókè láàárín àwọn ọmọdé yàtọ̀ láàkiri ìdá àkọ-n-bábo àti nípasè orihlẹ̀ èdè wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babone ukuthi ukukhula phakathi kwezingane kwehluka ngobulili nangezwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa girma a tsakanin yaran ya bambanta a tsakanin jinsi da kuma ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore kgolo gareng ga bana e fapane go ralala le bong le go ya ka naga.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የልጆቹ እድገት በጾታ እና በአገር እንደሚለያይ ተመልክተዋል።

English: Boys were generally taller but did not grow as fast as girls.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abalenzi baali bawanvu naye nga tebakulira ku mbiro nga bawala.
Yoruba: Àwon ọmọkùnrin a máa ga, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kìí ga kíákíá bí àwọn ọmọ obìnrin.
Zulu: Abafana ngokuvamile babebade kodwa babengakhuli ngokushesha njengamantombazane.
Hausa: Samari gabaɗaya sun fi tsayi amma ba sa girma kamar ’yan mata.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo bašemane ke ba bateletšana eupša ga ba gole ka pela go swana le basetsana.
Amharic: ወንዶች ልጆች በአጠቃላይ ረጅም ነበሩ ነገር ግን እንደ ሴቶች ልጆች በፍጥነት አላደጉም።

English: This means girls would reach their ‘tallest’ height earlier than boys, even though boys eventually grew past the girls’ height.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti abawala baali batuuka ku buwanvu bwanvu obusembayo manguko okusinga abalenzi, newankubadde ng’abalenzi baakulanga ne basukka ku buwanvu bw’abawala.
Yoruba: Èyí túnmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ọmọbìnrin máa deh òpin gíga wọn sáájú àwọn ọmọkùnrin, bí oh tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn ọmọkùnrin máa padà ga ju àwọn ọmọbìnrin lọ tí oh bá yá.
Zulu: Lokhu kusho ukuthi amantombazane azofinyelela ubude bawo ‘obude kunabo bonke’ ngaphambi kwabafana, nakuba abafana bagcina bedlule kobude bamantombazane.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin ‘yan mata za su kai ƙarshen 'tsayinsu' kafin samari, ko da yake a ƙarshe samari suna wuce tsayin ’yan matan.
Northern Sotho: Se se ra gore basetsana ba fihla botelele bja bona bjo ‘botelele bja mafelelo’ go feta bašemane, le ge e le gore mafelelong ba gola go feta botelele bja basetsana.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት ልጃገረዶች ከወንዶች ቀድመው ‘ረጅሙን’ ቁመት ይደርሳሉ ማለት ነው፣ ምንም እንኳን ወንዶች በመጨረሻ የሴቶችን ቁመት አልፈው ቢያድጉም።

English: The researchers also said shorter children generally grew faster than taller children.
Luganda: Abanooneyereza era baagamba nti okutwaliza awamu abaana abampiko baakulanga mangu okusinga ku abo abawanvuko.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí tún sọ pé àwọn ọmọ tí wọn kò bá ga máa ń tètè dàgbà ju àwọn ọmọ tí wọ́n bá ga lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi izingane ezimfishane ngokuvamile zikhula ngokushesha kunezingane ezinde.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ce gajerun yara gabaɗaya suna girma da sauri fiye da yara masu tsayi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gape gore bana ba bakopana ka kakaretšo ba gola ka lebelo go feta bana ba batelele.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአጠቃላይ አጫጭር ህጻናት ከረጃጅም ልጆች በበለጠ ፍጥነት ያድጋሉ ብለዋል።

English: Vietnamese children were the tallest, followed by Ethiopians, and lastly Indians and Peruvians.
Luganda: Abaana b’omu Vietnam be baali basinga obuwanvu, ne baddirirwa ab’omu Ethiopia, ate Abayindi n’ab’omu Peru ne basembayo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọ Vietnam ni ó ga jù, lẹ́yìn náà ni àwọn ọmọ Ethiopia, àwọn tih ó gbẹ̀yìn ni àwọn ọmọ India àti Peru.
Zulu: Izingane zaseVietnam zazizinde kunawo wonke, zilandelwa abaseTopiya, futhi ekugcineni amaNdiya namaPeru.
Hausa: Yaran 'yan Vietnam ne suka fi tsayi, sai Habashawa, sai kuma Indiyawa da kuma Peru a ƙarshe.
Northern Sotho: Bana ba Vietnam ba bile ba batelele kudu, gwa latela ba Ethiopia, gomme ba mafelelo ya ba ba India le Peruvia.
Amharic: የቪዬትናም ልጆች ረጃጅሞች ሲሆኑ ኢትዮጵያውያን ይከተላሉ፣ በመጨረሻም ህንዶች እና ፔሩያውያን ነበሩ።

English: By the age of 15, the average child’s height was 172 cm in Ethiopia, 170 cm in India, 171 cm in Peru and 174 cm in Vietnam.
Luganda: We baawerezanga emyaka 15, ng’omukkati gw’obuwanvu bw’abaana guli ku 172 cm mu Ethiopia, 170 cm mu Buyindi, 171 cm mu Peru ne 174 cm mu Vietnam.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbà tí yóò fi tó ọmọ ọdún 15, ìdajì gíga ọmọ tí tó 172 cm ní Ethiopia, 170 cm ní India, 171 cm ní Peru àti 174 cm ni Vietnam.
Zulu: Lapho eneminyaka engu-15 ubudala, isilinganiso sobude bengane sasingu-172 cm e-Ethiopia, 170 cm eNdiya, 171 cm ePeru kanye no-174 cm eVietnam.
Hausa: A cikin shekaru 15, matsakaicin tsayin yaro ya kai 172 cm a Habasha, 170 cm a Indiya, 171 cm a Peru da kuma 174 cm a Vietnam.
Northern Sotho: Ge ba fihla go mengwaga ye 15, palogare ya botelele bja bona ke disenthimetara tše 172 ka Ethiopia, tše 170 ka India, tše 171 ka Peru le tše 174 ka Vietnam.
Amharic: በ15 ዓመታቸው፣ የህጻናት አማካይ ቁመት በኢትዮጵያ 172 ሴሜ፣ በህንድ 170 ሴሜ፣ በፔሩ 171 ሴሜ እና በቬትናም 174 ሴሜ ነበር።

English: They said Ethiopian children reached adult height earlier than Indian children, but later than Peruvian children.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abaana b’omu Ethiopia baatukanga ku buwanvu bw’ekikulu manguko okusinga Abayindi, naye ng’ate ab’omu Peru balwawo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ọmọ Ethiopia máa ń tètè dé ìwọn gíga àgbàlagbà ju àwọn ọmọ India lo, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ọmọ Peru ṣi maha ń ṣájú wọ́n.
Zulu: Bathe izingane zase-Ethiopia zafinyelela ukuphakama kwabantu abadala ngaphambi kwezingane zaseNdiya, kodwa kamuva kunezingane zasePeruviya.
Hausa: Sun ce yaran Habasha sun kai girman manya kafin yaran Indiya, amma daga baya fiye yaran Peru.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore bana ba ka Ethiopia ba fihleletše botelele bja bona bja batho ba bagolo ka pela go feta bana ba ka India, eupša ka moragonyana ga bana ba Peruvia.
Amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ህጻናት ከህንድ ልጆች ቀድመው ለጎልማሳ ቁመት ቢደርሱም ከፔሩ ልጆች ግን ዘግይተው ይደርሳሉ ብለዋል።

English: Ethiopian and Vietnamese children grew at almost the same rate.
Luganda: Abaana b’omu Ethiopia ne Vietnam baakuliranga kumpi ku kigero kyekimu.
Yoruba: Bíi gbèdéke kan náà ni àwọn ọmọ Ethiopia àti Vietnam fi máa ń dàgbà.
Zulu: Izingane zase-Ethiopia naseVietnam zikhule cishe ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
Hausa: Yaran Habasha da Vietnam sun girma a kusan iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Bana ba Ethiopia le ba Vietnam ba gola ka kelo ya go lekana.
Amharic: የኢትዮጵያ እና የቬትናም ልጆች ከሞላ ጎደል በተመሳሳይ ምጣኔ አድገዋል።

English: The researchers said average height increased with age.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti obuwanvu obw’omukkati bweyongeranga ng’emyaka bwe gyeyongeranga waggulu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ìlàjì gíga máa ń lọ sókè pẹ̀lú ọjọ́ orí ni.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ukuphakama okumaphakathi kwanda ngokuya ngeminyaka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce matsakaicin tsayi yana ƙaruwa da shekaru.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore botelele bja tlwaelo go oketšegile go ya ka mengwaga.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አማካይ ቁመት በእድሜ እየጨመረ ነው ብለዋል።

English: Boys aged 1, 5, 8, and 15 were taller than girls, while only at an age of 12 were girls taller than boys for all the countries.
Luganda: Abalensi abaweza emyaka 1, 5, 8, ne 15 baali bawanvu okusinga abawala, so ng’ate ku myaka 12 abawala we baasingiranga abalenzi obuwanvu mu nsi ezo zonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọmọkùnrin tí wọ́n jẹ ọmọ ọdún 1, 5, 8, àti 15 ga ju àwọn ọmọbìnrin lọ, nígbàtí ó sì jẹ́ pé ní ọmọ ọdún 12 nìkan ní ọmọbìnrin ti maa ń ga ju ọmọkùnrin lọ ní gbogbo àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Abafana abaneminyaka engu-1, 5, 8, nengu-15 babebade kunamantombazane, kuyilapho beneminyaka engu-12 kuphela ababengamantombazane amade kunabafana kuwo wonke amazwe.
Hausa: Yaran masu shekaru 1, 5, 8, da kuma 15 sun fi ‘yan mata tsayi, yayin da suke da shekaru 12 kawai 'yan mata suka fi maza girma a duk ƙasashen.
Northern Sotho: Bašemane ba mengwaga ye 1, 5, 8, le ye 15 ba be ba le ba batrelele go feta basetsana, mola fela ka mengwaga ye 12 e be e le basetsana ba go feta bašemane ka botelele ka dinageng ka moka.
Amharic: የ1፣ 5፣ 8 እና 15 ዓመታት ወንዶች ልጆች ከሴቶች የሚረዝሙ ሲሆኑ፣ ሴቶች በ12 ዓመታቸው ብቻ በሁሉም ሀገራት ከወንዶች ይረዝሙ ነበር።

English: In the end, the researchers recommended a model that produced a growth chart in which height did not increase with age continuously, with no change at a certain age.
Luganda: Ku nkomerero, abanoonyereza baasemba omutetenkanyirizo ogwavaamu ekyoleko ky’enkula obuwanvu we buteeyongereranga na myaka mu ngeri ya kagenderere, ate nga ku myaka egimu tebwakyukangako.
Yoruba: Ní òpin, àwọn olùwádìí fi àbá àpẹẹrẹ kan lélẹ̀, èyí tí ó ṣe àgbéjáde ṣáàtì ìdàgbàsókè, èyí tí gíga kò tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ọjọ́ orí ní tèléǹtẹ̀lé, láì sí àyípadà ní ọjọ́ orí kan pàtó.
Zulu: Ekugcineni, abacwaningi batusa imodeli eyakhiqiza ishadi lokukhula lapho ukuphakama akuzange kukhule ngokukhula ngokuqhubekayo, kungekho shintsho eminyakeni ethile.
Hausa: A ƙarshe, masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar samfurin da ya samar da jadawalin girma wanda ba tsaywa tsayin bai ƙaru ba tare da shekaru, ba tare da wani sauyi a wata shekara ba.
Northern Sotho: Mafelelong, banyakišiši ba šišintše mokgwa wo o tšweleditšego tšhate ya kgolo yeo go yona botelele bo sego bja oketšega go ya ka mengwaga go tšwela pele, fao go be go se na le phetogo mo mengwageng ye itšego.
Amharic: በመጨረሻም፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በተወሰነ ዕድሜ ላይ ምንም ለውጥ ሳይኖር ቁመቱ ያለማቋረጥ በእድሜ የማይጨምር የእድገት ገበታን የሚያዘጋጅ ሞዴልን ጠቁመዋል።

English: The researchers, who were based in Ethiopia and South Africa, said the differences they observed among the children could be due to their living conditions.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abaali bava mu Ethiopia ne South Afirika, baagamba nti enjawulo gye baalabanga mu baana erabika yali eva ku mbeera mwe baabeeranga.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí, tí wọ́n tẹ̀dó sí Ethiopia àti South Africa sọ pé àwọn ìyàtọ̀ tí àwọn ṣe àkíyèsí láàárín àwọn ọmọdé la à jẹ́ látàrí ipò ìgbé ayé wọn.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi abazinze e-Ethiopia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathe umehluko abawubonile ezinganeni kungenzeka udalwa yisimo esiphila ngaphansi kwaso.
Hausa: Masu binciken, waɗanda suke zaune a Habasha da Afirka ta Kudu, sun ce, bambancin da suka lura a tsakanin yaran yana iya kasancewa ne saboda yanayin rayuwarsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši, bao ba bego ba le ka Ethiopia le ka Afrika Borwa, ba boletše gore diphapano tšeo ba di bonego gareng ga bana e ka ba ka lebaka la maemo a bona a bophelo.
Amharic: መቀመጫቸውን ኢትዮጵያ እና ደቡብ አፍሪካ ያደረጉት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ፣ በህፃናቱ ላይ ያዩት ልዩነት በኑሮ ሁኔታቸው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተናግረዋል።
